description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark], [Damage Cap +10000], [Stoneskin: 100%] and [Dark Armor Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Stoneskin: 100%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 100% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Dark Armor Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, Dark attacks grant 25% more SB points, casts Phantom Soul after using three Dark attacks, removed if user hasn't any Stoneskin
